title: relate-claims output
description: A verdict on how two claims from different papers relate. Anything but `none` becomes a proposed claim-to-claim edge; it is never accepted by itself.

direction.description: Which way the relation reads: `a_to_b` is 'a <relation> b'. `contradicts` and `none` use a_to_b.

evidence.description: Passage ids from the input (A1, B2, ...) that show the relation; at least one from each paper unless the relation is `none`.
